items.rss_summary:
The United States is reportedly readying new tariffs on China and 15 other trading partners following a months-long inquiry into state support and excess industrial capacity.
Results from the US Trade Representative (USTR) investigation may be announced as soon as this week, The Wall Street Journal reported on Tuesday, citing people familiar with the plans. The inquiry looked at whether subsidies and other measures had created overcapacity overseas, leading to a global flood of low-cost exports.
